findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: The test strips that were available at the facility were the incorrect strips for testing sanitizer concentrations. The strips were for testing pH levels. Demonstrated how to properly test sanitizer solutions with the PIC. Ensure that quaternary ammonia test strips are available to properly test sanitizer concentrations. Will follow-up on 1/6/2025 to ensure that test strips are available.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

(REPEAT) Observed the hand sink blocked by a pitcher. Cease practice. Hand sinks should remain free during all operational hours. Hnad sinks must be accessible to employees. Discussed with PIC and owner over the phone. Ensure staff is aware. Repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 11/1/21.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed the pizza grates of the pizza ovens to be heavily soiled with burnt food debris. The trays were clean. Ensure staff is aware to clean both the trays and the grates routinely to prevent food debris build-up. Discussed with owner over the phone and PIC. PIC began to wash, rinse, and sanitize during the inspection. COS.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: Observed a pitcher of sanitizer sitting inside the hand sink at the bar. The pitcher was moved to correct the violation. Hand sinks must be used for hand washing only.
(A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11  (C) Observed the metal box holding the in the walk in cooler fan to be peeling. Ensure the metal box is smoothed or painted and sealed to make it smooth and easily cleanable. Reference 6-201.11.
